description: This class 'ZoneLoader' loads zone configuration data from a JSON resource file ('zoneconfig.json') and deserializes it into a Java Map structure, utilizing Jackson's ObjectMapper for parsing.

classes.name: ZoneLoader
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading and parsing zone configuration data from a JSON resource file.

methods.name: loadZoneConfigurations
methods.description: Loads zone configuration data from a JSON file and returns it as a Map<String, List<ZoneTransient>>.
